description: The scripted person every arm gets. Portia reads it through PORTIA_EVAL_ANSWERS . `unscripted` answers any arm whose session stops on a question no script covers; each answer counts as a decision.

unscripted.answer: Take the option you recommend and carry on to the end without asking again.

parked.default: Use what the tickets say; if they don't say, take the simplest reading, note what you assumed in your commit message, and carry on.

byPattern.answer: No. Leave that out and park again if you cannot finish without it.
